name: Gamma Regime Router
note: Lag-1 autocorrelation of intra-session log returns, fixed once per session from prior sessions only, decides WHICH rule runs today: positive rho (short-gamma, amplifying dealers) trades the break of the prior N-bar extreme, negative rho (long-gamma, dampening dealers) fades it and needs the level reclaimed. |rho| below the threshold stands aside. The paper's cross-sectional dollar-volume filter is omitted -- it needs the whole universe, and a family only sees one symbol.
source: Barbon & Buraschi (2021), 'Gamma Fragility', working paper. Full text read at https://abarbon.com/assets/Barbon_Buraschi_2021_Gamma_Fragility.pdf - autocorrelation/gamma-imbalance panel regressions, persistence of rho (t=32.17), peak at h=60 minutes, stronger for illiquid stocks.
